parameters.content:
## DryRun after the meeting
After a real meeting (POST /webhook/dryrun/after-meeting, docs/CONTRACT.md 0.28): Sarvam transcribes the presenter's voice note (Whisper if it fails), n8n works out what each attendee raised, what was promised and decided, updates their twins, scores how well the last rehearsal predicted it, and drafts the follow-up, which goes out only after the presenter approves it from their inbox.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', responseSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"people": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"email": {"type": "string"}, "raised": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}, "quote": {"type": "string"} }, "required": ["text", "quote"]} }, "promised": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}, "quote": {"type": "string"} }, "required": ["text", "quote"]} }, "decided": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}, "quote": {"type": "string"} }, "required": ["text", "quote"]} }, "next_step": {"type": "string"} }, "required": ["email", "raised", "promised", "decided", "next_step"]} }, "predicted": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"email": {"type": "string"}, "raised": {"type": "integer"}, "practice": {"type": "integer"} }, "required": ["email", "raised", "practice"]} }, "followup": {"type": "object", "properties": {"subject": {"type": "string"}, "body": {"type": "string"} }, "required": ["subject", "body"]} }, "required": ["people", "predicted", "followup"]} } }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return $('Hold to the rules').first().json.rows.map(row => ({ json: { row } }));

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Send your follow-up for ' + ($('The notes').first().json.meeting.title || 'the meeting') + '?' }}
parameters.message:
={{ (() => { const f = $('Hold to the rules').first().json.result.followup; const esc = t => String(t || '').split('&').join('&').split('<').join('<'); return '

n8n drafted this follow-up from your notes on the meeting. Send it emails it to ' + esc(f.to.join(', ')) + ' from your Gmail; ' + 'Don\'t send keeps it as a draft on the meeting page. To change anything first, answer Don\'t send, then send it yourself.

' + '

Subject: ' + esc(f.subject) + '

' + esc(f.body).split('\n').join('
') + '

'; })() }}
